description:
One-token flow intelligence snapshot: returns net USD flows and wallet counts for smart traders, whales, exchanges, fresh wallets and public figures together in ONE response. Use for a trailing-window category summary, including the past 24 hours (timeframe=1d). Do not fetch a separate token-flows page for each category to construct this summary. Timeframe is 5m, 1h, 6h, 12h, 1d or 7d. For explicit start/end dates or paginated flow records use get_token_flows. Native ETH is read as WETH; the token must exist on the requested chain.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

chain.description: Chain name or slug, e.g. ethereum or base.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_smart_money_flows
